The short terms

Playing Abbie's World is free. These few lines only matter if you pay for support.

What we keep

When a grown-up signs in, we keep a one-way account number so your worlds can follow you, and nothing else about you: no name, no email, no profile. If you support Abbie's World, Stripe handles the payment and keeps your payment details; we only keep the Stripe customer number and the date you're paid up to.

Support: $5 a month

  • Each paid month gives your account $4 of AI magic in the game, such as talking to the Computer and having it build for you. The other $1 helps pay for the servers.
  • Unused magic doesn't carry over to the next month.
  • You can cancel any time from your support page. Cancelling stops the next payment, and the month you paid for stays yours.
  • Support is a purchase, not a charitable donation, so it isn't tax-deductible.
  • Only a grown-up may pay.

Always PG

Everything in Abbie's World stays PG. The Computer only helps with the game, and it may say no.

If we have to stop

Abbie's World is run by one person. If it has to be taken down, or if hosting it costs more than $1,000, it may be shut down. If that happens, every supporter gets back the unused part of the month they paid for.

Refunds and questions

If something went wrong with a payment, use the feedback button in the game or reply to your Stripe receipt, and we'll make it right.
